newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan govt debt at record high -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan govt debt at record high -- MOF.

text.p: The balance of outstanding Japanese government bonds stood at its highest level ever as of the end of March this year, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said in a statement.

The balance of outstanding government bonds was at 247.462 trillion yen at the end of March 1997, when the Japanese fiscal year ends, MOF said. The balance of outstanding bonds was at 227.975 yen trillion at the end of March 1996, it added.
It did give any details about the previous record high.
